title: Export selected dynamic customer receivable evidence page to Excel
description: User scene: download the currently selected, scoped invoice and receipt-allocation evidence page as xlsx, with explicit known/unknown remaining state and original currency. Revalidate current user, existing customer menu, salesperson scope, selected fields and page cap on every export; reuse ERP-117 preview and existing ExcelExporter. Text with spreadsheet formula prefixes must stay literal. No authoritative balance or cross-currency sum. Existing HTTP audit records the download. Development only: no model SQL, database writes, migration, real database execution, secret/.env change, or deployment. Verify workbook tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses the current authorized bounded preview and selected field order, rechecks menu/data scope and fails closed for invalid filters or out-of-scope customers.
Workbook uses existing ExcelExporter for only the current page, preserves currency and known/unknown/over-allocated remaining states, and keeps formula-leading text literal.
Designer downloads the selected report and handles authorization/empty failures; tests inspect xlsx fields, row cap, formula text and scope; document evidence limits.
